description: Authorizes a merge of one GitHub pull request, owner/repo#number, through the GitHub connector (github:pr-merge). Only a signed human approval for that exact pull request can authorize a merge. The caller-declared safety facts can refuse one, never authorize it. A merge is refused when the branch is not protected, the repository is not authorized, required reviews are not complete, a status check is not passing, or the risk score is above 3. Any other case is refused.

outcome.reason: Refused: no signed approval covers merging this pull request.
Refused: the branch, reviews, status checks or repository do not meet the merge requirements.
Refused: the risk score is above 3.
Merge approved: a signed approval covers this pull request. The caller-declared checks can refuse a merge, but they cannot authorize one.
Refused: the target is not a pull request reference.

unboundSignalReasons.branchProtected: Declared by the caller. No GitHub signal source exists yet to check this fact from GitHub. A caller can declare it true when it is not, so this is a known gap that the merge approval does not close. Until a signal source is built, the signed approval is the control that matters.
